title: Critical parameters and mechanism for hydrothermal polyethylene conversion
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, 3,5346-5355
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00674K, Paper
Open Access

Johan H. van de Minkelis, Anna E. de Waart, Rinke M. Altink, Ina Vollmer, Bert M. Weckhuysen
This work investigates the critical parameters for hydrothermal polyethylene conversion via a multi-analytical approach. The mechanism of the process was elucidated with supercritical water acting as a reactant through the formation of radicals.
